program: Whole dental-clinic cost; finite symptomatic relief quantified

nutshell.headline: Completed dental treatment is real; additional pain relief remains uncertain
nutshell.body: Our signed prior-weighted model yields 0.06310 Bay QALYs per $10,000 whole gift, or $1,584,848 per 10. This is an exploratory estimate, not measured clinic QALYs.
nutshell.whyItMayWork: Volunteer-supported dental treatment can relieve painful disease for patients who otherwise wait or cannot obtain care.
nutshell.whyWeAreCautious: The favorable 10% world supplies 86.5% of signed expectation. Symptomatic share, duration and funding response are assumptions.
nutshell.recommendationBlocker: HOLD a giving recommendation: current cash-created capacity and patient counterfactual outcomes remain unverified. The reported patient count is not a count of lives saved.

programSection.body: Dentists on Wheels, EIN 84-2234407, delivers free East Bay dentistry at the St. Vincent de Paul clinic in Pittsburg. Its 2024 return records 179 extractions, 228 fillings, 14 root canals, 50 crowns/bridges and 41 dentures, totaling 512 procedures for 249 additional patients across 50 clinic days.

steps.title: Pay whole historical organization cost
steps.detail: Include administration, staffing and all clinical services, even benefits not modeled.

steps.title: Identify unique symptomatic patient episodes
steps.detail: Start with 249 patients, not 512 procedures; apply a uniqueness/episode-equivalence judgment and symptomatic share.

steps.title: Relieve symptoms beyond realistic alternative care
steps.detail: Successful relief × utility gain × finite incremental duration until other care or need resolution. Not all fillings or dentures treat active pain.

steps.title: Model donor response and harms
steps.detail: Funding response reflects staff/volunteer/stock constraints and reserves; subtract incremental procedural/access harms before Bay attribution.

programSection.boundary: Only finite symptomatic relief is quantified. Prevention, chewing/denture function and other nonpain benefits remain unquantified, with costs retained. No lifetime, mortality, sepsis-prevention, income or screening-to-health credit. Partner infrastructure and volunteer opportunity costs are not free and not fully valued.

model.headline: $1,584,848 per 10 Bay QALYs
model.body: This historical-rate diagnostic does not promise a current purchasable slot. Primary completed-treatment evidence anchors scale; reported additional patients is not causal additionality. Patient-year/dedup and clinically useful pain episodes remain uncertain.

equation.label: Net Bay symptomatic health
equation.expression: gift / whole expense ×249 reported patients × funding response × (unique-episode factor × symptomatic share × successful relief × utility × incremental years − harm per patient) × Bay share

inputs.label: Whole 2024 expense
inputs.basis: Original return reconciles expense. Service value 621424 is fee-based valuation, not an additional validated resource bill.

inputs.label: Reported patients × unique episode factor
inputs.confidence: Moderate reported count; low episode conversion
inputs.basis: 249 additional patients is provider reported.512 procedures sum exactly but cannot become 512 people or pain relief episodes.

inputs.label: Symptomatic share × successful relief
inputs.basis: Procedure mix confirms treatment, not baseline pain or resolved symptoms. Completion is not a separate multiplier because procedures are reported completed; relief success is distinct.

inputs.label: Utility gain while relief is incremental
inputs.basis: Analyst judgment. Observational EQ5D before/after changes do not identify untreated causal benefit. No pain-scale/OHIP conversion.

inputs.label: Incremental symptomatic duration
inputs.basis: Until alternative dental care, spontaneous resolution or need resolution. Not tooth lifespan, treatment durability or lifetime. No independently measured local duration. Expected incremental painful time averages across zero-benefit/prompt-alternative and delayed-care patients, not three extra months for every eligible person. Funding response is the separate budget/capacity response, not this same access comparison.

inputs.label: New gift capacity response
inputs.basis: Lottery-like availability suggests constraint but not cash constraint; unrestricted assets 729582 and existing public/partner funding are funded baseline.

inputs.label: Bay health share
inputs.basis: East Bay clinic not proof every patient is Bay resident.

inputs.label: Independent incremental harm Q per patient
inputs.basis: Hypothetical postoperative pain/complications or access burden not already netted in utility; not observed adverse event rate.

model.uncertaintyBoundary: Selected-world mass below $1 M/10:0.1; below $100 k/10:0. These are judgments, not empirical probabilities. Without favorable world:$10,562,116 per 10.
model.fundingBoundary: 2024 revenue 196470 includes 30980 government grants. Cash 229364 plus savings 500218 equals 729582 net assets, all reported without donor restrictions at year end; zero liabilities. Surplus 92721 does not prove zero marginal need, but rejects an assumed emergency cash gap. Return records 59864 salary expense despite 0 employees; staffing classification unresolved, full cost retained. Partner rooms/equipment and 10685 reported volunteer hours imply substantial unpriced resources. Reported 621424 service fee value is not a rigorous opportunity cost measure and cannot simply be called donor leveraged QALYs.

evidence.result: 512 completed procedures reconcile to 179 extractions+ 228 fillings+ 14 root canals+ 50 crowns/bridges+ 41 dentures.
evidence.transfer: No untreated comparison, unique symptomatic episodes or measured utility. Do not mix newer secondary 2025 totals with 2024 cost.

evidence.design: Prospective dental practice before/after pain study
evidence.population: Root-canal patients, not all charity dental patients
evidence.result: Half reported severe pain before treatment; pain metrics improved after care.
evidence.transfer: No untreated counterfactual or QALY gain. Relieving dental pain is plausible, but magnitude/duration here remain judgments.

evidence.design: Swedish prospective nonrandomized root canal vs extraction cohort
evidence.population: 65 patients after third molar exclusions; 37 root canal initiations and 28 extractions
evidence.result: One-year QALYs rounded .83 in each group; no significant intergroup difference. Health state values rose .80 to .87 for root canal and .79 to .85 for extraction among available observations.
evidence.transfer: Active comparator null is not dental care vs no care null. Before/after rises may reflect confounding, recovery and missing data; .06/.07 is not imported as causal utility. 27% root canals incomplete by one year underlines need to distinguish starts/completions.

reservations: Whole cash/partial health scope is explicit; nonpain restorative benefits omitted, not zero.
Reported patients are not causal additional patients and multiple procedures may address one episode.
Pain utility and duration priors dominate evidence; no measured organization QALYs.
Large unrestricted reserves and volunteers make cash response uncertain.
Lottery-like access may reflect clinician availability, not a shortage of donations.
Source 2025 filing lead not primary recovered; model deliberately synchronized to 2024 financial/activity year.
Complete societal resource price unknown; headline does not value donated labor or partner capital fully.
excludedBenefits: Unquantified dentures/chewing and nonpain restorative function
Employment, confidence and social value bonuses
